name: NGC 7339, SN 1989L field (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 7339, an edge-on spiral galaxy that hosted the supernova SN 1989L, seen by Hubble.
label: sn1989l-hubble
story: Decades after SN 1989L burst out in the edge-on spiral NGC 7339, Hubble came back to its site. The search asks whether supernovae of the Type IIn kind truly end their stars, or whether something survives.

claims.text: SN 1989L was a supernova in NGC 7339
Spectra of SN 1989L showed a Type II supernova
NGC 7339 is an edge-on spiral galaxy
Program 17731 imaged SN 1989L's site as one of the confirmed Type IIn supernovae, asking whether they are terminal explosions
